newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish April T-bill auction draws lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish April T-bill auction draws lower rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Tuesday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.64 percent for the five month series and 3.75 percent for the nine month series.
One month ago, the five month series, at that time with a maturity of six months, yielded 3.75 percent, with the nine month series, then with 10 months maturity, yielding 3.95 percent.
The central bank said it sold 1.7 billion crowns worth of the five month series and 3.425 billion crowns worth of the 10 months series, giving a total of 5.125 billion crowns.
